spans.s:
mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Pure, purified, clean, cleansed.
2 Faultless, correct.
3 Alone, only, mere, simple.
4

White.
5

Whetted, sharp, (as an arrow.)
6 Authorised, admitted.
7

Innocent.
8

Acquitted.
n. (-द्धं)
1 Pure spirit.
2 Rock salt.
E.
शुध to be or make pure, &c., aff. क्त.

f. (-टिः)
One of the sides of a right-angled triangle.
E.
शुद्ध, and कोटि flank.

m. (-ङ्घः)
An ass.
E.
शुद्ध clean, pure, and जङ्घा the thigh or leg.

n. (-त्वं)
Purity, cleanness, freedom from soil or defect.
E.
त्व added to शुद्ध; also with तल्, शुद्धता.

mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्)
White-toothed, having handsome teeth.
E.
शुद्ध, and दत् for दन्त a tooth.

mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि)
Of pure understanding.
E.
शुद्ध, and धी intellect.

m. (-धः)
Simple putting to death, i. e. in any ordinary way.
E.
शुद्ध, and बध putting to death.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
1 Of pure or sincere purposes, honest, free from guile.
2 Intelligent.
m. (-तिः)
One of the Jaina pontiffs of the last age.
E.
शुद्ध pure, मति understanding.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Of a good colour, caste, &c.
2 Welllettered.
E.
शुद्ध, and वर्ण colour, &c.

f. (-का)
A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
E.
शुद्ध pure, वल्ली pedicle, कन् added, fem. form.

mfn. (-साः-साः-सः)
Clean, having clean vesture.
E.
शुद्ध, and वासस् clothes.

n. (-नं)
A figure of rhetoric.
E.
शुद्ध correct, and अनुमान inference.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A seraglio, a

Haram.
2

The private or women's apartments in the palace of a prince.
3 The king's wife or concubine.
E.
शुद्ध pure, and अन्त end, limit.

m. (-कः)
A eunuch or an attendant on the women's apartments.
E.
शुद्धान्त the Haram, and पालक a guard.

f. (-युक्)
Change of mode or key in music.

f. (-तिः)
A figure of rhetoric.
E.
शुद्ध correct, अपह्नुति concealment.

f. (-द्धिः)
1 Cleaning, cleansing.
2 Purity, purification.
3 Correction, correctness.
4 Innocence established by ordeal or trial, acquittal.
E.
शुध to be or make pure, &c., aff. क्तिन.

mfn. (-भृत्)
1 Clean, clear, free from soil.
2 Pure, virtuous.
E.
शुद्धि, and भृत् having.

m. (-नः)
King of KAPILA and father of ŚĀKYA.
E.
शुद्ध, and ओदन rice, food.

m. (-तः)
ŚĀKYA, the founder of the Bauddha sect.
E.
शुद्धोदन the father of this personage, and सुत son.

m. (-द्रः)
A man of the fourth or servile tribe, said to have sprung from the feet of BRAHMĀ.
f. (-द्रा)
A woman of the Śūdra tribe.
f. (-द्री or -द्राणी)
The wife of a Śūdra.
E.
शुच to purify or cleanse, Uṇādi aff. रक्, the vowel made long, and च changed to द.

f. (-ता)
The nature or condition of a Śūdra.
E.
शूद्र, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शूद्रत्वं.

m. (-र्म्मः)
The duty of the Śūdra tribe, the service of the other three.
E.
शूद्र a Śūdra, and धर्म्म moral merit.

m. (-ष्यः)
A man of the three first classes, who has become a servant to one of the fourth.
E.
शूद्र a Śūdra, and प्रेष्य a slave.

n. (-तं)
Alms begged or received from a Śūdra.
E.
शूद्र, and भिक्षित begged as alms.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Abounding with Śūdras.
E.
शूद्र, and भूयिष्ठ many.

m. (-कः)
A priest who conducts sacrifices for Śūdras.
E.
शूद्र, and याजक sacrificer.

n. (-ज्यं)
A country of which a Śūdra is king.
E.
शूद्र, and राज्य kingdom.

f. (-त्तिः)
The duty or occupation of a Śūdra.
E.
शूद्र, and वृत्ति employment.

n. (-नं)
An edict or grant, &c. addressed to persons of the servile caste.
E.
शूद्र a Śūdra, and शासन edict.

n. (-नं)
Marrying a Śūdra female.
E.
शूद्रा, and परिणयन marrying.

m. (-त्त्रः)
The son of any man by a Śūdra woman.
E.
शूद्रा, and पुत्त्र son; also शूद्रासुतः, &c.

f. (-र्त्ता)
A plant, Priyangu commonly.
E.
शूद्र a Śūdra, and आर्त्त pained.

n. (-नं)
Marrying a woman of the fourth class.
E.
शूद्रा, and आवेदन marrying.

m. (-दी)
A man of the three first classes, who has a Śūdra wife.
E.
शूद्रा, and आवेदिन् who marries.

m. (-र्य्यः)
The husband of a Śūdra woman.
E.
शूद्रा Śūdra woman, and भार्य्या a wife.

r. 1st cl. (सूदते) r. 10th cl. (सूदयति)
1 To leak, to drop, to flow, to distil.
2 To deposit, to place.
3 To hurt, to wound, to kill or attempt to kill.
4 To promise.
5 (In the causal form,) To hallow, to make holy or pure.

m. (-दः)
1 A cook.
2 Sauce, seasoning.
3 A made dish, any thing seasoned.
4 Split pease.
5 Mud, mire.
E.
षद to leak or distil, aff. अच् or घञ्.

m. (-णः)
A sovereign of Vidarbha.
f. (-णा)
The wife of DILĪPA.
E.
सु very, दक्षिण clever.

mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्)
Having handsome teeth.
E.
सु handsome, and दतृ for दन्त a tooth.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Well or properly given.
E.
सु, and दत्त given.

m. (-न्तः)
An actor, a dancer.
f. (-न्ती)
The female elephant of the N. W. quarter.
E.
सु good, handsome, and दन्त a tooth.

m. (-न्तः)
A follower of Śākya Muni, the teacher of the Bauddhas.
E.
सु well, and दान्त tamed, (whose passions).

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Easy to be subdued.
E.
सु, and दम taming.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नी-नं)
Handsome, good looking.
m. (-नः)
1 The discus of KṚṢṆ
Mount

Meru.
3

The rose-apple, (Eugenia jambu.)
4 The father of the eighteenth Jaina pontiff of the present era.
5 One of the nine Śuklabalas or BALARĀMAS of the

Jainas.
6

A vulture.
nf. (-नं-नी)
The city of INDRA.
f. (-ना)
1 A drug.
2 Order, command.
3 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
4 A woman, a handsome woman.
E.
सु good, दर्शन sight or appearance.

m. (-मा)
1 A cloud.
2 A mountain.
3 INDRA'S elephant.
4 The name of a cowherd.
5 The sea.
6 A poor Brahman raised to wealth and honours by KṚṢṆA.
E.
सु good, excellent, and दामन् a cord.

m. (-यः)
A special gift, as alms to a student at his initiation, a nuptial present, &c.
E.
सु auspicious, and दाय a gift.

m. (-रुः)
The Pāriyātra mountains, part of the Vindhya range.

ind.
The light half of the lunar month.

n. (-नं)
A fine day, fine weather.
E.
सु, and दिन a day.

n. (-हं)
A fine day.
E.
सुदिन fair weather, and अह for अहन् a day.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Happy daily, passing pleasant days.
E.
सु, and दिव a day.

mfn. (-र्घः-र्घा-र्घं)
Very long, (in space or time.)
E.
सु very, and दीर्घ long.

f. (-र्म्मा)
A plant, (Marsilia quadrifolia).

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Very wicked, abandoned, a profligate.
E.
सु very, दुराचार bad.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Inaccessible.
E.
सु and दुर with आङ before रुह to mount, क aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Difficult to be overcome.
E.
सु very, दुर्जय difficult to be conquered.

mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं)
Difficult to be beheld.
E.
सु very, दुर्द्दर्श difficult to be seen.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Difficult to be attained, unattainable, impracticable.
E.
सु very, दुर्लभ difficult.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Very arduous or painful, difficult to be performed or attained.
E.
सु very, दुश्चर arduous.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Very difficult.
E.
सु very, दुष्कर difficult.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Impassable, difficult to be passed or crossed.
E.
सु very, दुर् difficult, तॄ to cross, टच् aff.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Very difficult to be endured.
E.
सु very, दुस्सह unendurable.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Very distant.
E.
सु very, and दूर remote.

mfn. (-दृक्)
Having handsome eyes.
f. (-दृक्)
A pretty woman.
E.
सु excellent, and दृश् sight.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
Solid, firm.
n. adv. (-ढं)
Very hard or firm.
E.
सु very, and दृढ hard.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
1 Destructive, destroyer.
2 Dear, beloved.
n. (-नं)
Destroying, killing.
E.
षूद to injure or kill, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-ला)
A kitchen.
E.
सूद a cook, and शाला a hall.

m. (-क्षः)
Superintendant of the kitchen.
E.
सूद a cook, अध्यक्ष superintendant.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Destroyed, killed.
E.
षूद to destroy, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ता-ती-तृ)
Destroyer, destroying.
E.
षूद, तृन् aff.
